profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Snap | ex-Google | ex-Amazon
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer at Snap Inc. and M.S. in Computer Science with 9+ years of professional experience.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · On-site
positions.description:
Led a scalable Embedding-Based Retrieval (EBR) system launch
in the search pipeline that uses vector embeddings to improve
information retrieval. Leveraging ML features for search results ranking.
Embedded creator search queries using Qwen model in Vertex AI.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Payments Platform
In a server-driven software development, built next generation UI’s for one of the world's most used forms of payment (credit/debit).
Led the launch of a new comprehensive payments platform for the first time in the Play Store for cards payment in the US which is their biggest market. Simultaneously, leading this launch for RoW countries.
Performing A/B testing, analyzing metrics and monitoring real time data.
Designing and scoping to support additional forms of payments, and focus on operational excellence, oncall shifts and mentoring.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Being part of Purchase and Checkout team, contributed to the launch of Audible Plus by enhancing checkout experience and developed necessary backend purchase APIs. Focused on operational excellence.
Dived deep into core checkout work-flow to solve a long running problem of US customers missing tax invoices.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
As an integral part of AWS Billing and Taxes department, implemented a localization client in a Tax service to support multiple languages enabling our platform for global launches, along with generalizing US tax exemption.
Solved a critical problem of AWS customers taxed incorrectly, resulted in saving annual loss in millions.
Designed low level implementation and owned the tax component of AWS Country launch for South Africa and AWS Marketplace launch for EMEA.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as a Team Lead of an Agile Team focused on enhancing a website for providers (doctors) associated with UHG network. Has demonstrated an ability to take project from designing phase to the production.
Deeper understanding and experience of working in Microservice Architecture. Knowledge and experience of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and encourages best practices for coding, testing and version control.
Provided technical leadership to the team especially for Java backend services. For backend work, I am involved in creating more consumable REST API’s using Apache Camel integrated in Java for other platforms.
Day-to-day work in Agile environment and tools such as Rally. Supporting Test Driven Development (TDD) by encouraging team to implement Junit tests, automated tests for UI and system tests in Jenkins (CICD tool).
Designing and enhanced DBaaS (Database as a Service) and implemented it on MongoDB and Elastic Search.
Solved the major problem of syncing data between the instances/pods in OpenShift cloud platform by implementing distributed cache clustering. Worked on Smooks for Java-to-Java Mapping and Drools for Business Rules Validation, both implemented in Java.
POC on websocket connection to live stream data and enabling push notification to display dynamic messages.
Building consumer and producer REST API’s as a streaming platform for the current project using Apache Kafka.
As a Big Data Developer, I used Sqoop and Pig scripts for ETL process to load data into Hadoop from RDBMS.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Designed web pages that are SEO optimized and administering Wordpress powered website. Worked on enhancing company’s website for better user-experience.
Maintained reports via Google analytics, and providing aid in ongoing analysis and monitoring. 
Offering knowledge support on networking and troubleshooting maintenance plans for Web server.
Assisted in selecting and understanding functionalities of new CRM, and migrated existing data to the new CRM.

positions.title: QA Intern
positions.description: During my internship at CLS, I was working on two projects where I learnt about Selenium and AutoQA tools. In addition, I understood automated testing and built scripts for testing. Another project was to understand Maximo-IBM defect management tool and analyze their defects. Using that analysis, I had to import and automatically update defects into Jira. Furthermore, I learned functionalities of Jira. I had good exposure of the business side. Lastly, presented the pertinent aspects of the strategic pillars of the organization to the CEO and EMC members.

volunteerExperiences.description: At America’s Grow-a-Row’s mission, I volunteered twice to positively impact the healthy eating and provide foods to those in need through efforts of picking cabbages and planting soy beans.
